⭐ Ofsted rated Lancashire Outstanding. Now let's talk about what comes next.

Most of what I write is about failure, because most of what government does right now is fail. So let me use this one differently.

Ofsted's report on Lancashire County Council children's services:
⭐ Impact of leaders on social work practice — OUTSTANDING
⭐ Experiences and progress of care leavers — OUTSTANDING
✅ Children who need help and protection — GOOD
✅ Children in care — GOOD

Inspectors heard children in care say they "feel listened to and looked after well".

Being straight with you: this builds on a Good judgement in 2022. It's years of graft by social workers, personal advisers and family hub staff — and they deserve to hear that said out loud.

Ofsted also flagged real work still to do: young carers, safety plans, and oversight of children in unregistered placements. Outstanding doesn't mean finished.

And there's £23 million on the table for SEND provision closer to home — better for the child, cheaper for the taxpayer. Those two things rarely line up. When they do, you act.
